description: This Java source file defines the RomTree class, a custom Swing JTree component for displaying and interacting with ROM and related nodes in the RomRaider tuning software. It includes event handling for mouse clicks and key bindings, and methods for managing selection and display of associated tables.

classes.name: RomTree
classes.description: A custom Swing JTree component for displaying ROM and related nodes with mouse and keyboard interaction capabilities.
